chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Fear Allah to some degree (even) though it be little; and set a curtain between you and Allah (even) though it be thin.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to fear Allah with minimal devotion according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this concise maxim from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) emphasizes the cumulative value of consistent, albeit small, acts of piety, reflecting the Shia principle that steadfastness in minor duties prevents spiritual neglect. The metaphor of a 'curtain' (sitr) highlights the importance of divine modesty and the preservation of one's inner spiritual state, ensuring that one's relationship with God remains protected from the gaze of worldly distractions or self-complacency.
